description.en: Count objects, compare quantities, and make number bonds within 20.
description.zh: 數物件、比較數量，並建立 20 以內的數的組合。

description.en: Use pictures, ten frames, and number lines for simple addition and subtraction.
description.zh: 用圖像、十格架和數線處理簡單加減。

description.en: Name common 2D shapes and continue repeating visual patterns.
description.zh: 辨認常見平面圖形，並延續重複視覺規律。

description.en: Compare length, mass, capacity, and read simple o'clock times.
description.zh: 比較長度、重量、容量，並讀出整點時間。

description.en: Read, write, order, and decompose three-digit numbers.
description.zh: 讀寫、排序和分拆三位數。

description.en: Connect repeated addition, arrays, and early multiplication facts.
description.zh: 連繫重複加法、陣列和初階乘法事實。

description.en: Solve simple Hong Kong money questions and read half-hour times.
description.zh: 解決簡單香港貨幣題，並讀出半小時時間。

description.en: Measure in centimetres and read simple pictographs or bar charts.
description.zh: 以厘米量度，並閱讀簡單象形圖或棒形圖。

description.en: Use times tables, equal groups, and sharing to solve number problems.
description.zh: 使用乘數表、等量分組和平均分解決數題。

description.en: Represent halves, thirds, quarters, and simple equivalent fractions.
description.zh: 表示二分之一、三分之一、四分之一和簡單等值分數。

description.en: Choose suitable units and solve length, mass, and capacity questions.
description.zh: 選擇合適單位，解決長度、重量和容量題。

description.en: Explore symmetry, right angles, grids, and growing patterns.
description.zh: 探索對稱、直角、方格和增長規律。

description.en: Read, round, compare, and calculate with larger whole numbers.
description.zh: 讀寫、取近似值、比較和計算較大的整數。

description.en: Compare tenths and hundredths and connect decimals to money and measures.
description.zh: 比較十分位和百分位，並連繫小數、金錢和度量。

description.en: Classify angles, estimate sizes, and use simple angle facts.
description.zh: 分類角、估計角度大小，並使用簡單角度性質。

description.en: Find perimeter and area for rectangles and composite shapes.
description.zh: 求長方形及組合圖形的周界與面積。

description.en: Add, subtract, compare, and simplify fractions in familiar contexts.
description.zh: 在熟悉情境中加減、比較和約簡分數。

description.en: Build volume from cubes and calculate cuboids.
description.zh: 由小立方體理解體積，並計算長方體體積。

description.en: Compare unit prices, speeds, and other rate situations.
description.zh: 比較單價、速度和其他率的情境。

description.en: Read charts, calculate averages, and explain data comparisons.
description.zh: 閱讀圖表、計算平均數，並解釋數據比較。

description.en: Convert between fractions, decimals, percentages, and real contexts.
description.zh: 在分數、小數、百分數和實際情境之間轉換。

description.en: Scale quantities, share in a ratio, and reason proportionally.
description.zh: 按比例縮放、按比分配，並作比例推理。

description.en: Connect distance, time, and speed with tables and graphs.
description.zh: 用表格和圖像連繫距離、時間和速率。

description.en: Plan multi-step questions using diagrams, tables, and clear checking.
description.zh: 用圖、表和清晰檢查規劃多步驟題目。

description.en: Visualize negative numbers, operations, and number-line movement.
description.zh: 透過數線視覺化負數、運算與移動。

description.en: Translate patterns into expressions and simple equations.
description.zh: 把規律轉化為代數式和簡單方程。

description.en: Explore angle relationships using draggable diagrams.
description.zh: 使用可拖曳圖形探索角的關係。

description.en: Connect proportional reasoning to everyday Hong Kong contexts.
description.zh: 把比例推理連繫到香港日常情境。

description.en: Read charts, compare averages, and interpret variation.
description.zh: 閱讀圖表、比較平均數並理解變異。

description.en: Solve equations and see balance models react instantly.
description.zh: 解方程並觀察天平模型即時變化。

description.en: Plot points, lines, and transformations on grids.
description.zh: 在坐標網格上標示點、直線和變換。

description.en: Animate reflection, rotation, translation, and enlargement.
description.zh: 以動畫呈現反射、旋轉、平移與放大。

description.en: Compare theoretical probability with simulation data.
description.zh: 比較理論概率與模擬數據。

description.en: Factor, expand, and recognize algebraic structure.
description.zh: 因式分解、展開並辨識代數結構。

description.en: Connect tables, graphs, and the shape of a parabola.
description.zh: 連繫數表、圖像與拋物線形狀。

description.en: Build sine, cosine, and tangent from right triangles.
description.zh: 由直角三角形建立正弦、餘弦和正切。

description.en: Investigate chords, tangents, arcs, and angle theorems.
description.zh: 探究弦、切線、弧和圓周角定理。

description.en: Model input-output rules and connect them to graphs.
description.zh: 建立輸入輸出規則並連繫到圖像。

description.en: Use slope, distance, and midpoint in geometric problems.
description.zh: 以斜率、距離和中點解決幾何問題。

description.en: Manipulate identities, indices, and rational expressions.
description.zh: 處理恆等式、指數與有理式。

description.en: Interpret distributions and evaluate data claims.
description.zh: 詮釋分佈並評估數據主張。

description.en: Compare polynomial, exponential, and logarithmic models.
description.zh: 比較多項式、指數和對數模型。

description.en: Transform identities and graphs for senior secondary questions.
description.zh: 為高中題目轉化恆等式與三角圖像。

description.en: Build counting strategies and conditional probability intuition.
description.zh: 建立計數策略和條件概率直覺。

description.en: Link gradients, tangent lines, and rate of change.
description.zh: 連繫斜率、切線和變化率。

description.en: Use derivatives and integrals to solve exam-style problems.
description.zh: 運用導數與積分解決考試題型。

description.en: Reason with normal distribution, sampling, and data summaries.
description.zh: 運用常態分佈、抽樣與數據摘要推理。

description.en: Plan revision by skill gaps, timing, and mixed paper practice.
description.zh: 按能力差距、時間管理和混合試卷規劃溫習。

description.en: Select strategies for multi-step unfamiliar questions.
description.zh: 為多步驟陌生題選擇解題策略。

description.en: Count, compare, compose, and decompose small whole numbers.
description.zh: 认读、比较、组成和分解20以内的数。

description.en: Recognize simple solids, describe positions, sort objects, and read whole-hour clocks.
description.zh: 认识简单立体图形，描述位置，按特征分类，并认读整时。

description.en: Use tens and ones, make ten, and solve addition or subtraction stories.
description.zh: 理解十位个位，运用凑十和分解解决加减问题。

description.en: Read simple money, clock, and category-count situations.
description.zh: 读懂简单人民币、时间和分类统计情境。

description.en: Connect equal groups, repeated addition, arrays, and multiplication facts.
description.zh: 联系几个几、连加、阵列和乘法口诀。

description.en: Choose length units, compare measures, identify angles, and reason from views.
description.zh: 选择长度单位，比较测量结果，认识角，并从不同方向观察物体。

title.zh: 表内除法与有余数除法

description.en: Use sharing, grouping, multiplication facts, and remainder checks.
description.zh: 用平均分、包含分、乘法口诀和余数检查解决除法问题。

title.en: Place Value, Mass, Time, and Data
title.zh: 万以内数、质量、时间与数据

description.en: Read thousands, compare numbers, use mass and time units, and read simple tables.
description.zh: 认识万以内数，比较数的大小，运用质量和时间单位，并读取简单统计表。

title.zh: 多位数运算与分数初步

description.en: Estimate, calculate with place value, and name equal parts as fractions.
description.zh: 估算并用位值计算，认识平均分成的几分之一和几分之几。

description.en: Use units, elapsed time, simple angles, and pattern reasoning.
description.zh: 运用计量单位、经过时间、简单角和规律推理。

description.en: Separate area from perimeter and connect decimals with money or measures.
description.zh: 区分面积和周长，并把小数与钱数、长度等量联系起来。

description.en: Read small data displays and solve short mixed review tasks.
description.zh: 读取小型统计图表，解决短小综合复习问题。

title.zh: 大数认识与三位数乘法

description.en: Read, compare, round, estimate, and multiply larger whole numbers.
description.zh: 读写、比较、改写、取近似数，并计算较大整数乘法。

description.en: Estimate and measure angles, classify angle types, and use basic geometry language.
description.zh: 估计和度量角，辨认角的类型，并使用基本几何语言。

description.en: Compare and calculate decimals, convert units, and interpret averages.
description.zh: 比较和计算小数，进行单位换算，并理解平均数的含义。

description.en: Use perimeter and area formulas and distinguish parallel or perpendicular relations.
description.zh: 运用周长和面积公式，辨别平行与垂直关系。

description.en: Calculate with decimals, express unknowns, and solve simple equations.
description.zh: 进行小数乘除，表示未知数，并解简易方程。

description.en: Find areas of parallelograms, triangles, and trapezoids by decomposition.
description.zh: 通过转化和分割求平行四边形、三角形和梯形面积。

description.en: Classify factors and multiples, simplify fractions, and add or subtract fractions.
description.zh: 辨认因数和倍数，约分通分，并进行分数加减。

description.en: Use volume units, calculate cuboids and cubes, and interpret small data displays.
description.zh: 运用体积单位，计算长方体和正方体体积，并解释小型数据图表。

description.en: Connect fractions, decimals, percentages, discounts, and growth contexts.
description.zh: 联系分数、小数、百分数、折扣和增长情境。

description.en: Use ordered pairs, directions, and sector-style data reasoning.
description.zh: 使用数对、方向和扇形统计图式的数据推理。

description.en: Model ratios, direct proportion, inverse proportion, and scale.
description.zh: 建立比、正比例、反比例和比例尺模型。

description.en: Interpret negative numbers and solve multi-topic transition review tasks.
description.zh: 理解负数意义，并解决跨知识点的升学衔接复习问题。

title.en: Rational Numbers and the Number Line

description.en: S1 upper begins junior algebra by extending whole-number arithmetic to signed rational numbers, number-line comparison, absolute value reasoning, and reliable operation strategies.
description.zh: 围绕有理数与数轴基础建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕有理数与数轴基础建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.zh: 整式初步与一元一次方程
title.zhHans: 整式初步与一元一次方程

description.en: This card covers the move from arithmetic statements to algebraic language: represent quantities with letters, simplify linear expressions, and solve one-variable linear equations from original contexts.
description.zh: 围绕整式初步与一元一次方程建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕整式初步与一元一次方程建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

description.en: S1 geometry establishes precise language for points, lines, segments, rays, angles, and simple spatial objects so learners can describe and reason about figures clearly.
description.zh: 围绕几何图形初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕几何图形初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.en: Intersecting Lines, Parallel Lines, and Coordinates
title.zh: 相交线、平行线、实数与平面直角坐标系
title.zhHans: 相交线、平行线、实数与平面直角坐标系

description.en: S1 lower links line-angle relationships, geometric language, translation, real-number foundations, and coordinate representation so learners can justify geometric conclusions, estimate roots, and locate or move points precisely.
description.zh: 围绕相交线、平行线、实数与平面直角坐标系建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕相交线、平行线、实数与平面直角坐标系建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.zh: 二元一次方程组、不等式与数据初步
title.zhHans: 二元一次方程组、不等式与数据初步

description.en: This card extends equation modeling to two unknowns, introduces inequality solution sets, and begins data collection and interpretation with attention to what the data can support.
description.zh: 围绕二元一次方程组、不等式与数据初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕二元一次方程组、不等式与数据初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

description.en: S2 upper develops triangle reasoning through side-angle relationships, congruence criteria, and symmetry properties as a bridge from observation to proof.
description.zh: 围绕三角形、全等与轴对称建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕三角形、全等与轴对称建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.en: Polynomial Products, Factorization, and Algebraic Fractions
title.zh: 整式乘法、因式分解与分式
title.zhHans: 整式乘法、因式分解与分式

description.en: This card strengthens symbolic manipulation by connecting polynomial products, factorization strategies, algebraic fractions, and equation checks.
description.zh: 围绕整式乘法、因式分解与分式建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕整式乘法、因式分解与分式建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.zh: 二次根式、勾股定理与平行四边形
title.zhHans: 二次根式、勾股定理与平行四边形

description.en: S2 lower connects exact radical computation with geometric measurement and quadrilateral classification, especially right-triangle reasoning and parallelogram properties.
description.zh: 围绕二次根式、勾股定理与平行四边形建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕二次根式、勾股定理与平行四边形建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

description.en: This card introduces function-as-relationship thinking through linear graphs, formulas, and contextual interpretation while deepening data summary and comparison.
description.zh: 围绕一次函数与数据分析建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕一次函数与数据分析建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.zh: 一元二次方程、二次函数、圆与概率初步
title.zhHans: 一元二次方程、二次函数、圆与概率初步

description.en: S3 upper consolidates algebraic and geometric reasoning through quadratic equations, quadratic functions, rotation, circle properties, and introductory probability models.
description.zh: 围绕一元二次方程、二次函数、圆与概率初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕一元二次方程、二次函数、圆与概率初步建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

title.en: Inverse Proportion, Similarity, and Right-Triangle Trigonometry
title.zh: 反比例函数、相似与锐角三角函数
title.zhHans: 反比例函数、相似与锐角三角函数

description.en: S3 lower prepares learners for senior-secondary mathematics by combining inverse-proportion functions, similarity, right-triangle trigonometry, and spatial-view reasoning.
description.zh: 围绕反比例函数、相似与锐角三角函数建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。
description.zhHans: 围绕反比例函数、相似与锐角三角函数建立概念、方法、易错点诊断和原创练习迁移。

description.en: Use sets, relations, propositions, and sufficient or necessary conditions.
description.zh: 运用集合、关系、命题以及充分条件与必要条件。

title.zh: 一元二次函数、方程和不等式

description.en: Connect quadratic graphs, roots, intervals, and inequality solving.
description.zh: 联系二次函数图像、方程根、区间与不等式求解。

description.en: Study domain, range, monotonicity, parity, inverse relations, and function models.
description.zh: 学习定义域、值域、单调性、奇偶性、反函数关系与函数模型。

description.en: Compare exponential and logarithmic growth, equations, and transformations.
description.zh: 比较指数与对数增长、方程和图像变换。

description.en: Use unit-circle values, identities, graph features, and simple transformations.
description.zh: 使用单位圆取值、恒等变换、图像特征和简单变换。

description.en: Represent vectors, calculate dot products, and solve planar geometry tasks.
description.zh: 表示向量、计算数量积，并解决平面几何问题。

description.en: Operate with complex numbers and connect algebraic and geometric meanings.
description.zh: 进行复数运算，并联系代数形式与几何意义。

description.en: Reason about spatial lines, planes, distance, angles, and simple solids.
description.zh: 推理空间直线、平面、距离、角度与简单几何体。

description.en: Summarize data with averages, variance, percentiles, and distribution language.
description.zh: 用平均数、方差、百分位数和分布语言概括数据。

description.en: Model random events, sample spaces, complements, and simple compound probability.
description.zh: 刻画随机事件、样本空间、对立事件和简单复合概率。

description.en: Use coordinates and vectors to calculate spatial distance, angle, and position.
description.zh: 用坐标和向量计算空间距离、角度与位置关系。

description.en: Build equations of lines and circles and use coordinate constraints.
description.zh: 建立直线与圆的方程，并运用坐标约束。

description.en: Analyze ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas, intersections, and parameter constraints.
description.zh: 分析椭圆、抛物线、双曲线、交点和参数约束。

description.en: Work with arithmetic and geometric sequences, sums, recursion, and induction.
description.zh: 处理等差数列、等比数列、求和、递推和归纳。

title.zh: 一元函数的导数及其应用

description.en: Use derivatives for tangent lines, monotonicity, extrema, and optimization.
description.zh: 用导数研究切线、单调性、极值和最优化。

description.en: Apply permutations, combinations, binomial expansion, and counting cases.
description.zh: 应用排列、组合、二项式展开和分类计数。

description.en: Use discrete distributions, expectation, variance, binomial models, and normal ideas.
description.zh: 运用离散分布、期望、方差、二项分布模型和正态思想。

description.en: Interpret correlation, regression, residuals, and data-based decisions.
description.zh: 解释相关、回归、残差和基于数据的判断。

description.en: Combine derivative rules, parameter analysis, inequalities, and optimization.
description.zh: 综合导数规则、参数分析、不等式和最优化。

description.en: Combine lines, circles, conics, vectors, and parameter reasoning.
description.zh: 综合直线、圆、圆锥曲线、向量和参数推理。

description.en: Mix counting, probability, distributions, regression, and interpretation.
description.zh: 综合计数、概率、分布、回归和解释。

description.en: Practice original multi-topic tasks with clear strategy selection and checking.
description.zh: 练习原创跨章节任务，强调策略选择和结果检验。

title.en: BNU Junior: Rich World of Figures

description.en: This S1 upper opening builds spatial language for common solids, visible structure, object views, and nets so learners can connect real objects with mathematical descriptions.
description.zh: 北师大版七年级上册《丰富的图形世界》初中单元，围绕solid-geometry-introduction、spatial-figures、views-of-objects、nets开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。
description.zhHans: 北师大版七年级上册《丰富的图形世界》初中单元，围绕solid-geometry-introduction、spatial-figures、views-of-objects、nets开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。

title.en: BNU Junior: Rational Numbers and Operations

description.en: This unit introduces signed rational numbers, number-line meaning, absolute value, and operation rules with attention to sign, order, and reasonableness.
description.zh: 北师大版七年级上册《有理数及其运算》初中单元，围绕rational-numbers、number-line、opposite-absolute-value、signed-number-operations开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。
description.zhHans: 北师大版七年级上册《有理数及其运算》初中单元，围绕rational-numbers、number-line、opposite-absolute-value、signed-number-operations开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。

title.en: BNU Junior: Algebraic Expressions and Addition/Subtraction

description.en: Learners move from arithmetic descriptions to algebraic expression structure, simplifying polynomials by identifying like terms and preserving sign meaning.
description.zh: 北师大版七年级上册《整式及其加减》初中单元，围绕algebraic-expressions、monomials-polynomials、like-terms、polynomial-addition-subtraction开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。
description.zhHans: 北师大版七年级上册《整式及其加减》初中单元，围绕algebraic-expressions、monomials-polynomials、like-terms、polynomial-addition-subtraction开展原创概念讲解、练习与错因诊断。
